Revision record

Changelog

This page records visible site-level changes so returning readers can see what changed between updates. It is not a Git commit log; it summarizes public-facing editorial and interface changes.

13 September 2026

Catalogue parity and ten-edition source section

  • Synced Maithili and English catalogue counts at 36 selected works.
  • Grouped genre filters consistently across languages and removed duplicate year/category artifacts.
  • Expanded the source-edition hub to ten supplied editions, including the full Diwan-e-Videha Khand 2, Sahasrabadhani and Sahasrashirsha.
  • Reworked Akulait Sur unit notes to distinguish ghazal, kavita, geet and child-reader visual/sound units.
  • Clarified Reading Tools citation guidance, Panji access routes and large-file warnings.

10 September 2026

Bilingual guide expansion

  • Added bilingual guide routes and source-grounded chapter/unit records for major Gajendra Thakur works.
  • Added contributor/reception material and improved cross-language navigation for criticism and source pages.

9 September 2026

Initial public atlas framework

  • Established bilingual homepages, selected works, timeline, source notes, Reading Tools and criticism/reception structure.
